use default

kronecker(left: int[][], right: int[][]) -> int[][] =>
    (0..left.count * right.count)
        |> map(row => (0..left[0].count * right[0].count)
            |> map(column =>
                left[row / right.count][column / right[0].count] *
                    right[row % right.count][column % right[0].count])
            |> collect_array())
        |> collect_array()

pad(text: string, width: int) -> string =>
    if text.length >= width then
        text
    else
        pad(" {text}", width)
    fi

show(matrix: int[][]) is
    let width = matrix
        |> flat_map((row: int[]) => row |> map(value => "{value}".length))
        |> reduce(1, (widest, length) =>
            if length > widest then length else widest fi)

    matrix
        |> each((row: int[]) => write_line(row
            |> map(value => pad("{value}", width))
            |> join(" ")))
si

for pair in [(left = [[1, 2], [3, 4]], right = [[0, 5], [6, 7]]),
             (left = [[0, 1, 0], [1, 1, 1], [0, 1, 0]],
              right = [[1, 1, 1, 1], [1, 0, 0, 1], [1, 1, 1, 1]])] do
    show(kronecker(pair.left, pair.right))

    write_line("")
